item.title: Marina City Manager Layne Long announces retirement after 13 years
item.description: After 13 years of leadership implementing and overseeing policies crafted by the city council, documenting and presenting the city budget and interacting with the community to develop new programs, Layne Long will close his 38-year career in city management when he retires effective July 17.

item.title: Watch live: President Donald Trump’s State of the Union speech
item.description: The address is likely to be a test run of the message Republicans will give to voters in November’s elections.

item.title: Monterey hosting traffic study for Prescott Avenue, Taylor Street
item.description: The city will host the Prescott Traffic Signal Study community outreach meeting on March 5, from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. at the Hilltop Park Center, 871 Jessie Street.
